overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, mainly reflecting mid-range ERC/BI readings, but a strong storm moving in is set to push danger down to Low for the rest of the week.**
- Danger falls to Low starting tomorrow and stays there through Nov. 6, as ERC and BI percentiles drop into the single digits/teens.
- Sunday's storm brings rain and snow showers, then thunderstorms, with a 100% chance of precipitation and a high near 50.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are met
